JobDescription:
Job Title: Graphic Designer

Location: Bangalore [Hybrid]

About Company

Client is an AI-powered healthcare automation company committed to transforming the way providers and patients connect. Our virtual assistants streamline patient communication, reduce administrative burden, and elevate the standard of care delivery. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup backed by top-tier investors, and we’re building a new category of AI-driven, voice-first infrastructure for healthcare systems across the U.S. Confido Health is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment decisions based on protected characteristics like race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

Graphic Designer (Female Candidates Only)

 Location: Bangalore, HSR Layout

Mode: 3 days work from office

 Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role:

We are looking for a creative and experienced Graphic Designer (Female candidates only) who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role will involve working closely with cross-functional teams to develop impactful visual content across digital, social, and brand channels.

If you are someone with a keen eye for design, a strong portfolio, and the ability to balance aesthetics with functionality — we’d love to connect!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create engaging graphics and visual assets for web, social media, presentations, and campaigns

  • Design brand-aligned creatives including logos, infographics, illustrations, and UI components

  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and content teams to understand project needs and deliver high-quality visuals

  • Develop short-form and long-form video content (basic editing and animation preferred)

  • Maintain brand consistency across all creative outputs

  • Stay updated with industry trends and tools to bring fresh ideas to the table

Must-Have Skills:

  • 5+ years of proven experience in graphic design

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Figma, Canva (Photoshop, Premiere Pro or After Effects is a plus)

  • Strong portfolio showcasing a wide range of creative projects (link required)

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in dynamic environments

  • Excellent communication, time management, and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Fine Arts, Communication, or a related field

  • Experience with video editing tools and motion graphics

  • Understanding of user-centric design and branding principles

How to Apply:

Please share your updated resume along with a link to your design portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Why Join Us?

  • Collaborative work culture

  • Creative freedom and ownership

  • Opportunity to shape visual identity across digital channel
